en.headline: Nine named Outstanding Young Persons, including fencer and jockey
en.dek: The 2026 selection was announced at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, with foil fencer Choi Chun-yin and jockey Vincent Ho among the nine recipients.
body: Organisers of the Ten Outstanding Young Persons Selection named nine recipients on Tuesday at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai. Sing Tao reported this year's theme as 「睿見耀光 匯傑領航」.

Among those named were foil fencer Choi Chun-yin, who has just competed at the Nagoya Asian Games, and jockey Vincent Ho, winner of the 2023 International Jockeys' Championship. Cable News described Choi as Hong Kong's first fencing world-championship gold medallist and said he also took two Asian Games silver medals. Choi told the ceremony he had entered the selection before without being chosen, and that optimism was a habit that had to be trained rather than something people were born with.

Sing Tao reported the other recipients across public service, education and professional work. In public and community service they were 林珮盈, a clinical assistant professor in paediatric dentistry at the University of Hong Kong; 林榮杰, a haematology specialist; and 龍允生, executive chairman of the Hong Kong Youth Exchange Promotion Association. In education they were 楊銳湘, founder and head coach of Stride Running Club, and 曹之胤, associate dean of City University's School of Energy and Environment. In professional work they were registered music therapist 鍾敬文 and chief physiotherapist 陳效民.
The selection is an annual civic award rather than a government appointment. The organisers said the nine were recognised for work in their own fields and for their contribution to the community.

zh.headline: 十大傑青揭曉 劍擊蔡俊彥及騎師何澤堯在列
zh.dek: 2026年十大傑出青年選舉周二在灣仔會展公布，九人獲選，包括剛完成名古屋亞運的劍擊選手蔡俊彥及騎師何澤堯。
body: 「十大傑出青年選舉2026」周二在灣仔香港會議展覽中心公布結果，今屆共有九人獲選。星島日報引述主辦方，今年主題為「睿見耀光 匯傑領航」。
獲選者包括剛完成名古屋亞運的中國香港劍擊代表隊成員蔡俊彥，以及2023年國際騎師錦標賽總冠軍何澤堯。有線新聞形容蔡俊彥是香港首位劍擊世錦賽金牌得主，並在亞運取得兩面銀牌。蔡俊彥在台上說，數年前曾參選但未獲選，又指樂觀不是與生俱來，要靠後天訓練養成習慣。
星島日報報道，其餘獲選者來自公共及社會服務、教育及專業工作。公共及社會服務界別包括香港大學兒童齒科臨床助理教授林珮盈、血液學專科醫生林榮杰，以及香港青年交流促進聯會執行主席龍允生。教育界別包括奮進跑步會創辦人及總教練楊銳湘，以及香港城市大學能源及環境學院副院長曹之胤。專業工作界別包括註冊音樂治療師鍾敬文及首席物理治療師陳效民。
這是一項年度民間選舉，並非政府委任。主辦方表示，九人分別在自身領域有所表現，並對社會有所貢獻。
